name: Collect Microsoft AD user assets (on-premise)
description: Run one collection cycle of the Microsoft Active Directory Users asset connector. Started by on-premise asset connectors, not meant for playbooks.

asset_connector_uuid.title: Asset connector UUID
asset_connector_uuid.description: The asset connector configuration receiving the assets

connector_configuration_token.title: Connector configuration token
connector_configuration_token.description: The token sending the logs of the asset connector configuration

sekoia_base_url.title: Sekoia.io Base URL
sekoia_base_url.description: The base URL of the Sekoia.io API

sekoia_api_key.title: Sekoia.io API Key
sekoia_api_key.description: The API key to authenticate to Sekoia.io

batch_size.title: Chunk Size
batch_size.description: Number of assets to send in each batch to Sekoia.io

basedn.title: Base DN
basedn.description: The base distinguished name (DN) to use for LDAP queries

pushed_batches.description: Number of batches pushed to Sekoia.io

failed_batches.description: Number of batches Sekoia.io did not accept

has_more.description: Whether the collection cycle stopped before its end and must run again
